Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.ftpclient.session

Class TransferJob

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.ftpclient.session.TransferJob
public final class TransferJob extends Object
One queued file transfer: a direction (upload/download), the local and remote paths, and the live progress/state the transfer-queue table renders.

A job is a mutable, thread-safe status object rather than the transfer itself: the TransferManager runs it (usually on a worker thread) and updates the volatile counters here, while the Swing table model reads them on the EDT. Cancellation is cooperative - requestCancel() sets a flag the manager's ProgressListener polls, so an in-flight copy stops at the next buffer boundary.
